notes.title: Game Updated. (Oct 21th)
notes.content:
Hi PM fans

How have you been?
Hope everything goes well with you all~ :)

Here comes the new patchnote for today

1. Additional start mode add as「Start from the beginning(Skip Opening Intro)」
※ From now on, you can choose to skip the opening intro from the game start
2. Enhanced English localization text has been implemented.
3. Minor bugs Fix(Specifically, bug on game freeze due to possessing items condition)

We will keep trying to perfect Princess Maker. 
Please have us informed further.

Best regards
CFK
